credits.name: nflverse games.csv
credits.credit: Game results and closing lines from nflverse (Lee Sharpe and contributors), https://github.com/nflverse/nfldata.

gaps: No moneyline prices from 1999 through 2005. 2006 is partial. Prices are effectively complete from 2007, with a thinner 2008.

Spreads use nflverse spread_line, which is positive when the home team is favored. Home covers when home_score - away_score is greater than spread_line. A missing spread price is graded at -110 (1.909).
The current season stays partial until every scheduled game has a score. Upcoming games are not graded.

definitions.season: NFL season year. Wild-card through Super Bowl stay in that season, not the calendar year of the game.
definitions.phase: regular is game_type REG. playoff is WC, DIV, CON, and SB.
definitions.moneyline: Flat 1.00 unit at the nflverse closing American price, stored as decimal. A tie is a refund: counted in pushes and ties, excluded from stake and ROI.
definitions.ats: Flat 1.00 unit. Pushes are counted and excluded from stake and ROI. Favorite and underdog follow the spread, not the moneyline. A zero spread is a pick'em and is left out of both.
definitions.calibration: Two-way de-vig p = (1/odds) / ((1/home) + (1/away)). Buckets are 5 percentage points of that probability. Brier score is the mean squared error of those probabilities. Average overround is the mean of (1/home + 1/away - 1) across priced games. Ties are left out.
definitions.sampleSize: played counts final scores. bets counts decided prices. pushes are refunds.
definitions.franchise: OAK is Las Vegas, SD is the Chargers, STL is the Rams. Each relocated club is one franchise.
